description: Fix profile avatars not showing in DM interface. Currently message_item.tsx renders a div.dm-message-item__avatar-placeholder (gray circle) instead of an actual with the account's avatar URL. Similarly, chat_room_item.tsx and chat_room_header.tsx show placeholder divs. The API response includes full account objects with avatar URLs (via REST::AccountSerializer which includes avatar and avatar_static). The reducer normalizes messages keeping account_id but discards the account object. Fix by: storing account data in state and rendering actual avatar images.
steps: Update app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts: (a) Add an 'accounts' field to DmState (Record<string, {id: string, username: string, display_name: string, avatar: string, avatar_static: string, acct: string}>). (b) In normalizeMessage, also store the account data. (c) When messages are fetched (DM_MESSAGES_FETCH_SUCCESS), extract accounts from all messages and merge into state.accounts. (d) When chat rooms are fetched (DM_CHAT_ROOMS_FETCH_SUCCESS), extract participant accounts and merge into state.accounts. (e) When a message is received via streaming (DM_MESSAGE_RECEIVED), also store the account from the payload.

Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_item.tsx: (a) Add an optional account prop with avatar/display_name fields. (b) Replace the .dm-message-item__avatar-placeholder div with an tag using the account's avatar_static URL when showAvatar is true and account is available. (c) Update the sender-name display to show account.display_name or account.username instead of message.account_id.
Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/message_list.tsx: Look up the account from state.dm.accounts using message.account_id and pass it to MessageItem as a prop.

Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_item.tsx: (a) Get participant accounts from the DmState.accounts map (the room has participant_ids). (b) For direct rooms, show the other participant's avatar. For group rooms, show the first participant's avatar (or a group icon). (c) Replace .dm-chat-room-item__avatar-placeholder with an actual tag.

Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_header.tsx: (a) Accept accounts data (from parent or selector). (b) Show the other participant's avatar in direct rooms, or first participant avatar in group rooms. (c) Replace .dm-chat-room-header__avatar-placeholder with an actual tag.
Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_view.tsx: Pass accounts context to ChatRoomHeader if needed.

Add CSS for avatar images in dm.scss: .dm-message-item__avatar-img, .dm-chat-room-item__avatar-img, .dm-chat-room-header__avatar-img with proper sizing (24px for message, 48px for list item, 36px for header), border-radius: 50%, object-fit: cover.
acceptance_criteria: Message items show actual profile photos from the account's avatar_static URL
Chat room list items show actual participant avatars
Chat room header shows the participant's avatar
Sender names in group chats show display_name instead of account_id numbers
Graceful fallback to placeholder if avatar URL is missing/fails to load
Avatar images are properly sized and circular
verification: Run: npx tsc --noEmit --project /projects/sandbox/mastodon/tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -50 || echo 'TS check done'
Verify message_item.tsx contains elements with avatar URLs
Verify the reducer stores account data from API responses
findings: TypeScript compilation passes cleanly. Added accounts store to DmState, populated it from all data sources (room fetch, messages fetch, message received, room updated). Updated all UI components to show real avatars with graceful placeholder fallback.
